title: pkg/api/handlers/libpod: test quadlet uploads under a low descriptor limit
body:
## What

Adds a regression test for the quadlet multipart upload descriptor leak.

The leak itself was fixed upstream in #29762 (94b0c1df14), which landed while this
PR was in review and closes each part and file per loop iteration. After rebasing on
main (and dropping the merge commit), the refactor this PR originally carried became
redundant, so it has been removed and only the test remains.

## Why

The existing `TestProcessMultipartQuadlets` cases upload at most three files, so they
would not catch the leak coming back. The new test lowers `RLIMIT_NOFILE` to 64 and
uploads 256 quadlets; a per-part descriptor leak fails the request with
"too many open files". The limit is restored in `t.Cleanup`, and the test skips if
the hard limit is below 64.

#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?

```release-note
None
```
